text:
Buffalo played the better game and lost by three. BUF out-attempted CBJ 56 to 39, finished with 2.85 expected goals to 2.12, and would win 63 percent of simulated replays. The difference was Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, who allowed 2.9 goals more than the 22 shots he faced deserved, while Jet Greaves was close to even against his workload.

The first period set the score. Mattias Samuelsson scored at 7:21 on a 6 percent chance, but CBJ answered with Cole Sillinger at 12:51 and then Matthew Knies on a power play at 17:58. Adam Fantilli deflected one in at 18:44, 46 seconds later, and CBJ led 3-1 after out-chancing BUF 1.10 to 0.55 in expected goals. Buffalo was never ahead again.

Buffalo's best stretch came in the second, where it held a 1.73 to 0.47 edge in expected goals. Jack Quinn and Konsta Helenius scored, but Knies tipped in a 9 percent chance at 7:45 to keep CBJ ahead. Tage Thompson had a 23 percent look stopped by Greaves, and BUF went 0 for 5 on the power play. Sean Monahan converted a CBJ power play at 14:21 of the third, and Mathieu Olivier closed it with a goal on a chance too small to register, giving CBJ a 6-3 win. Knies finished with two goals and an assist, and Charlie Coyle had three assists.
